label: Lin & Lee (2008)
units: PGA, SA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA, rock and soil) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Lin & Lee (2008)

magnitude.note: Foreign supplementary data extend to ~8.1. Do not assume that extends every coefficient branch.

site.anchor_note: Resolved from the two reported coefficient sets.

mechanism.anchor_note: No mechanism term; C7 is the event-type flag, not a fault-style flag.

event_type.note: Douglas notes subduction-related event types; enumerate them from the paper.
event_type.anchor_note: RESOLVED from C7_intraslab_flag: intraslab is flagged against an interface reference.

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period table for both site branches. PGA coefficients C1-C7 and sigma for rock and soil are now available.

implementation_notes: Test the Taiwan-only magnitude range and the foreign-supplemented high-magnitude end separately.

aleatory.note: A single total sigma per site branch; no tau/phi split in the anchor.

resolution_provenance.distance.min_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmin 15 km (rhypo)
resolution_provenance.distance.max_km: Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 1 (PGA characteristics table): rmax 630 km (rhypo)
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/lin_lee_2008.py coefficient table; period count and range (27 periods, 0.01-5 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked.
